findings.description: Floyd Jennings built a camera obscura on the terrace below the Cliff House, facing the sea: a 17.5-foot square redwood-sided room with a rotating hood on the roof holding a mirror and a lens of 150-inch focal length, which cast a moving panorama of Seal Rocks, Ocean Beach and the Marin coast onto a six-foot white parabolic table. findings.description: Built as a meat-packing plant and smokehouse for Armour & Company, the Chicago packer, one of the firms that took the local meat trade after the earthquake: three storeys and a basement of load-bearing brick around heavy timber posts and beams, designed by Henry Geilfuss & Son, across the street from the National Ice & Storage Company's cold stores.
